top_signals.title: Citadel's Esposito on Bank Partnerships, Fixed Income Growth
top_signals.summary: Citadel Securities President Jim Esposito discusses the firm's relationship with banks, plans to grow in the fixed income market and his views on prediction markets with Bloomberg's Dani Burger on the sidelines of Citadel's annual Future of Global Markets Conference in New York. (Source: Bloomberg)
